d: Namaste, I recently rode the new Himalayan 750 from Royal Enfield. While we are still waiting for the price and launch in India, it is now confirmed that it will be launching at Motoverse Goa this month, and, considering European pricing, it should cost less than RS 4.5 lakh ex-showroom in India. This video covers all the important aspects you'll want to know about the Himalayan 750's riding characteristics.
